piezas.titulo: Speaking practice: Recounting an experience and ordering events
texto: Integrated conversation: narrating a past experience at a social gathering or in an interview. At Advanced level you should be able to relate unexpected events without getting stuck, linking ideas fluently: «ตอนนั้น...หลังจากนั้น...ในที่สุด...». Practise narrating with natural intonation, modulating the rhythm when describing the moment of tension and the relief of the outcome.
